question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_2025_ORDERS, COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1) AS MULTI_LINE_ORDERS, COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::FLOAT AS SHARE_MULTI_LINE_ORDERS, AVG(IFF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1, ITEM_QUANTITY, NULL)) AS AVG_ORDERED_UNITS_ONE_LINE, AVG(IFF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1, ITEM_QUANTITY, NULL)) AS AVG_ORDERED_UNITS_MULTI_LINE, COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0) AS NO_ITEM_LINE_ORDERS FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'

action.answer: Among 4,359,773 orders recorded in 2025, 3,052,089 had more than one item line, a 0.700057 (70.005686%) share of all orders. Average ordered units per order were 1.219753 for one-line orders and 3.484769 for multi-line orders. No-item-line orders: 0.
